tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md
jq -r '[.stack_frames[0],.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3],.stack_frames[4],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 FS $2 FS $3 FS $4; s[k]+=$5; if($5>0)p[k]+=$5;else n[k]+=-$5} END {for(k in s) print s[k],p[k]+0,n[k]+0,k}'"' | sort -nr | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0],.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 FS $2 FS $3;s[k]+=$4;if($4>0){p[k]+=$4;pc[k]++}else{n[k]+=-$4;nc[k]++}} END{for(k in s) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",s[k],p[k]+0,n[k]+0,pc[k]+0,nc[k]+0,k}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k1,1nr | head -30
jq -r '[(if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end),.stack_frames[0],.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3],.labels.source_session[0]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '"'$2=="result:repeated"{k=$1 FS $3 FS $4; sum[k]++; sess[k FS $5]=1} END{for(k in sum){ns=0;for(x in sess)if(index(x,k FS)==1)ns++; print sum[k],ns,k}}'"' | sort -nr | head -25
jq -r '[(if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end),.stack_frames[0],(.value|if .<0 then -. else . end)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 FS $2;s[k]+=$3}END{for(k in s)print s[k],k}'"' | sort -nr"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [(if .value>0 then \"candidate/bad\" else \"base/good\" end), ((.value|if .<0 then -. else . end)|tostring), .labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{ops["'$1]+=$2; seen[$1 SUBSEP $3]=1} END {for(k in ops){n=0; for(x in seen) if(index(x,k SUBSEP)==1)n++; printf "%s'"\\toperations=%d\\tdistinct_source_sessions=%d\\n\",k,ops[k],n}}' | sort
jq -r '[(if .value>0 then \"candidate/bad\" else \"base/good\" end), ((.value|if .<0 then -. else . end)|tostring)] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{n["'$1]+=$2} END{for(k in n)print k,n[k]}'"' | sort"
